target.title: Refine Claude Team seat tier display
target.body:
## Summary
- parse Claude web account membership seat_tier values for Team Standard and Team Premium display
- refine generic Claude Team labels only inside the existing Claude web-extras/web usage path, preserving the OAuth/CLI source boundary
- keep primary OAuth/CLI identity fields unchanged when web metadata is used only for plan label refinement

## Security/source-boundary fix
- The PR no longer performs an account-only /api/account lookup before the web-extras gate.
- OAuth/CLI paths with web extras disabled do not read Claude web cookies or backfill web account email.
- Added regression coverage for the disabled-web-extras path to keep the generic Claude Team label and leave accountEmail unchanged.

## Validation
- DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer swift build
- DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer swift test --filter 'ClaudePlanResolverTests|ClaudeWebUsageExtraWindowTests|oauth team login method is not refined when web extras are disabled'

## Notes
I only have access to a Claude Team Premium account. Team Standard is covered by unit tests using the observed seat_tier value, but the actual UI display should still be verified with a real Team Standard account.
